notes.title: Villainous Newsletter Launch
notes.notes:
Greetings Villains!

We've launched our brand new newsletter, so now you can keep up to date with all the mischievous happenings at the evilest game studio in town.

[h3]What can you expect  when signing up?[/h3]

As a special treat you will be able to download a creepy Harvest Hunt wallpaper once you sign up, so your screens can enter the spooky season in style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41418617/5411cf71199c7ff553d8ab3c6844fd6bbed10bb8.png[/img]

We're also planning to:

[list]
[*] Keep you up to date with all major evil schemes at our studio
[*] Give you exclusive behind the scenes peeks at the development of our games
[*] Let you be the first to know about discounts and sales
[/list]

[h3]Sign-ups[/h3]

Head over to our [url=https://subscribepage.io/UuOCX4]sign-up page[/url] to join and start your villainous journey. 
Remember you'll have to confirm your subscription via the confirmation email before you're fully initiated!

notes.title: New Dev Diary Series - Only on Discord!
notes.notes:
[i]Do you get bored reading long dev blogs?

Are you still interested in the behind-the-scenes but you just do not have the patience or time to read long blog posts about?

Do you wish you could just know a little bit about the game but not investing too much?[/i]

Well then, this is the right dev diary for you! Presenting you Horror Stories: Developer Edition!

Under 2 minute reads, funny and weird short stories will be posted to our Discord every Friday! We have a dedicated channel for it and a dedicated team making mistakes* every week to keep you entertained!

Become a Villain and join our Discord to keep up to date with our shenanigans!

And guess what! [b]Our first post is out NOW! [/b]Join us! https://bit.ly/3YgjwLh 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41418617/3753b1a2b1f7f365f696e89057a8ac7b61ebdee3.png[/img]

*our team is amazing

notes.title: Our Evil Lair is now open - join today!
notes.notes:
Every good villain needs an evil lair and we’re very happy to announce that ours is now open for Villains far and wide! Join our shiny new Discord server [url=https://bit.ly/44KArbB]here[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43833426/61216f74457087e8fd485c7fec9dfd36d1b0b68b.png[/img]
[b]To further entice you to indulge your Villainous side, the first 50 people to join the Discord will receive a free copy of our first game, Please Comply, so don’t delay![/b]

Here you’ll be able to talk to fellow villains, make plans to take over the world, discuss which animals make the evilest pets and who has the best henchmen. Outside of work, we like to discuss our favourite horror films, theories around what Please Comply really means and of course, memes.

This will also be where we share important updates about our games, patch notes and general studio news.

It will also be where you, as fellow villains, will be able to shape our games by sharing your feedback and letting us know what you’d like to see. With Horror Stories: Harvest Hunt currently under development we’re always open to hear what you want to see more (and less) of!

See you in there!

notes.title: Lunar New Year Sale 2022
notes.notes:
[h1]Happy Lunar New Year everyone![/h1]

Our CMD:Studio team is celebrating this traditional festival, and we invite you to join us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41418617/467bafc270b4169ccabe6309935004eecbc747b8.png[/img]

For the duration of the Steam Lunar New Year Sale you can purchase [b]Horror Stories: PLEASE COMPLY[/b] with a [b]30%[/b] discount. So if it’s been sitting in your Wishlist, now is the best time to COMPLY and try it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41418617/6c2f2350b8b01ced1daf127e35df560d44da36a0.png[/img]

We’ve been working hard to release the update, which includes:
[list]
[*] [b]Performance optimisation[/b]. You can enjoy the full experience even on a machine with lower technical specs without any loss to the game’s quality.
[*] [b]Disk space[/b]. The overall game size is now reduced to ~900MB (half the original size!).
[*] [b]Achievements[/b]. We added 12 Steam achievements for you to collect. Let’s see how many you can uncover!
[/list]

We would also like to thank you for playing Horror Stories: PLEASE COMPLY. Your support is priceless, and we hope you share your experience with us!

notes.title: Horror Stories: PLEASE COMPLY is out on Steam now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41418617/9a4868dde974f09536c56631f18871a92f3ff75e.jpg[/img]We here at CMD: Studio are delighted to release our first title, Horror Stories: PLEASE COMPLY, here on Steam for £2.89/$3.99.

In this first person interaction horror game, you are trapped in a strange room with only one exit.
Surely that is where you need to go, but something...someone is begging you not to go through
it. 

[b]Watch the trailer here:
[/b][previewyoutube=7H-C47E7r5c;full][/previewyoutube]

Horror Stories: PLEASE COMPLY is a short game created to whet your appetite for the creepy
and disturbing, serving as an introduction to a larger world of upcoming titles under the umbrella
of The Horror Stories Anthology, which will commence with 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1696450/Welcome_Home/]Horror Stories: Welcome Home[/url]

If you've not heard about us that may be because this is our first official game release, which we wanted to be short enough to not eat up your time but also be packed with intrigue and questions. It is an introduction to a future series of feature length games we're working on.

Feel free to check us out on [url=https://twitter.com/cmdstudiogames]Twitter [/url]and our [url=https://www.cmdstud.io/]website[/url]. We'll have more exciting news to share soon.
